visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a white long-sleeved sweatshirt with a black snake graphic on the right sleeve, leans over a grey textured fabric ottoman. He smiles slightly while examining the stitching and material with his hands, set against a background of shelves with LEGO models and a bicycle in a brightly lit modern living room. (2) The man is seen attaching a matching grey headrest to the top of the sofa section; a yellow neon sign reading 'Hhn Home' glows on the white wall behind him, adding a warm ambiance to the scene. (3) The character sits comfortably on the newly assembled L-shaped grey sofa, holding a black remote control in his right hand and looking toward an off-screen television with a relaxed facial expression. (4) Close-up shots pan across the sofa's surface, highlighting the dense weave of the grey fabric and the clean lines of the furniture legs and cushions, emphasizing the physical state and texture of the material. (5) A hand is shown wiping a clear liquid droplet off the sofa cushion using a white tissue; the liquid remains beaded on the surface, demonstrating the fabric's water-resistant properties in the well-lit room. (6) The man sits on the sofa, leaning his head back while holding a white ceramic mug, looking out toward a large window with natural daylight filtering through white curtains. (7) A close-up shows the man focused on reading a book with a red and white cover, his head slightly tilted down as he rests on the soft sofa cushions. (8) The man is seen lying down and sleeping peacefully on the long section of the grey sofa, with a laptop open on a nearby desk and the 'Hhn Home' sign visible in the background. (9) A wide shot captures the entire living room arrangement, featuring the complete grey sofa set, the neon sign, and the modern decor elements under soft, balanced indoor lighting. (10) The screen transitions to a stark white background where black Chinese characters appear centrally, marking a shift from the representational imagery to a text-based conclusion.
